caption:
AI agents were just caught finding each other without anyone asking. Here are 5 to run your business tonight, free.

1) The Overnight Brief (Claude)
3 minutes before bed. Wake up planned.
"Here are my emails from today: [paste]. Tomorrow's meetings: [paste]. Give me: the 3 most urgent replies, what to prepare for each, anything missed."

2) The Crisis Scanner (Claude)
Monday morning, paste this week's brand mentions. Claude finds the fires.
"Here are mentions of my business this week: [paste]. Flag anything that could blow up. For any negative mention with real traction, draft a 2-sentence response I can post."

3) The Weekly Report Writer (Claude)
Friday paste. Monday, team update ready.
"Here is what happened in my business this week: [paste]. Write a 300-word summary: what we achieved, what's open, what needs a decision Monday. Plain language."

4) The Prospect Researcher (Grok)
Night before a sales call. Wake up prepared.
"Search for [Name] at [Company]. Find: what they sell, recent news, 3 pain points I might solve. Write one sentence to open our call that shows I researched them."

5) The Sunday Agenda Builder (Claude)
Sunday evening. Monday mapped before your alarm.
"Here is my calendar next week: [paste]. My 3 goals: [list]. Build a day-by-day plan. One paragraph per day: Monday priority, what to prepare, what to push back."

SAVE THIS: 5 prompts. One for each job. Paste in your content, get a full brief back in under a minute.

AI agents found each other today without anyone asking. The tools doing that are the same ones in this guide. These five cover 80% of the prep most business owners do manually every week.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Anthropic, xAI, Reuters
